summary: Example [junos:vars] for NETCONF uses netconf, junipernetworks.junos.junos, user, vaulted password and ansible_netconf_proxy_command for a bastion.
questions: What inventory do I need for Junos over NETCONF?
How do I set a jump host for Junos NETCONF?

answer_card.title: Junos NETCONF inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[junos:vars]
ansible_connection=ansible.netcommon.netconf
ansible_network_os=junipernetworks.junos.junos
ansible_user=myuser
ansible_password=!vault |
ansible_netconf_proxy_command='-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
Note the NETCONF proxy variable is `ansible_netconf_proxy_command`.
